model.title: A resolution supporting the designation of September 18, 2026, as "National Concussion Awareness Day".

summary.text: The resolution supports designating September 18, 2026, as National Concussion Awareness Day and recognizes that mild traumatic brain injury, also called a concussion, is an important health concern. It commends the groups and people who raise awareness about it and encourages federal, state, and local policymakers to work together to raise awareness of concussion effects and to improve understanding of how concussions are diagnosed and managed. It also encourages further research and prevention efforts so that fewer people suffer the most serious effects of mild traumatic brain injury.
